mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 69 degrees with heavy rain down at Harriet Park. Tonight, the temperature will dip to a low of 60 degrees with more rain expected. For you space fans, the Space Station will be visible at 4:10 AM tomorrow, rising in the Southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling high across the sky toward the East Northeast over the Fitchburg and Madison area.

The City of Verona has two big updates. First, the Department of Public Works is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects with a deadline of September 20. Additionally, the city has a rain barrel rebate program where residents can receive a 30 dollar credit on their utility bill for installing qualifying rain barrels.

There is plenty to do this week starting today with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison or catch music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, the Girls Try Hockey event is this Saturday, and we have various trivia nights and a downtown market starting next week.

Regarding the weekly report, on Friday, August 15, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for a first offence O W I after discovering her passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.

Cool off with our tasty Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day at Culver's, which is open until 10:30 PM tonight. You can also catch the Kona Ice truck today at the Verona Area High School football game starting at 6 PM.
